claim_boundary: Offline policy replay over two independently measured, complete f64 Contract corpora. Every method uses the same canonical finite pool and the same unique-candidate budget. Design workloads fit the calibrated prior, validation workloads select hyperparameters, and holdout runtimes are revealed only after BaCO selects a candidate. Results do not establish multithreaded, non-row-major, non-x86, or end-to-end application generalization.
